h: Tope Alabi marks her birthday quietly amid legal dispute over online claims tied to Toluwanising's death
p: Gospel singer Tope Alabi marked her birthday with a low-key post while reportedly facing a legal dispute over online claims linked to the death of Toluwanising.
more: The burial dispute involving Toluwanising's relatives is still ongoing.
An old video of Toluwanising praising his wife has also resurfaced online.
